controls.label: ruff format
controls.note: Pure formatting. Safe to enforce repo-wide on day one because the fix is mechanical and reviewable in one commit.

controls.label: ruff check
controls.note: Start with the E/F/I rule sets only. Widening the rule set on a legacy repo is a separate, later task.

controls.label: mypy
controls.note: On legacy code enable per-module, not globally. mypy.ini ships with strict off and a per-module opt-in block.

controls.label: pytest
controls.note: The behaviour harness. Without it every other control only regulates form, not correctness.

controls.label: coverage floor
controls.note: Ship with --cov-fail-under set to the CURRENT measured value, then ratchet. A floor above current coverage blocks every commit on arrival.

controls.label: pre-commit
controls.note: Shifts the fast controls left. Install last: a hook that fires before the underlying tools are clean makes the repo unusable.

controls.label: CLAUDE.md conventions
controls.note: Merged into the repo's CLAUDE.md. Costs nothing to install and starts steering immediately.
